meta.title: Art of Menu Sales Partner Programme: Sell QR Menus to Restaurants, Earn Commission
meta.desc: Sell Art of Menu to restaurants and cafés with your own code. Keep 100% of the net first monthly payment on Menu, or a fixed €100 on a yearly Smart sale. No targets, no quotas.
meta.ogtitle: Become an Art of Menu sales partner
meta.ogdesc: Show cafés the QR menu and keep the first month. A yearly Smart sale pays a fixed €100.
hero.h1: Show cafés the QR menu. Keep the first month.
hero.lead: You introduce Art of Menu to restaurants and cafés, they subscribe with your code, and you take a share of their first payment. No targets or quotas, and you don't need a company to join.
hero.art: The Art of Menu menu on a guest's phone, the order that reaches the waiter, and the commission booked to the partner
prod.label: What you bring to the table
prod.h2: A product you can open on your phone and hand to the owner.
prod.intro: The screen does most of the talking. Open the menu on your phone, show the order arriving on the waiter's phone, and explain how prices move towards the evening. There are three plans, each one building on the last.
plan.menu.text: Guests scan the QR code and the menu opens in their language. Product photos, allergens, set menus, a PDF menu and the business's own domain are all in this plan.
plan.order.text: Guests send their order from the menu and it pops up on the waiter's phone. Calls for the waiter, water or the bill come through the same screen. Unlimited tables at no extra cost.
plan.smart.text: Prices update every day within limits the owner sets, based on weather, time of day and special dates. When a guest picks a product, the menu suggests what that branch sells with it most often.
prod.fine: Prices are per branch. Paying yearly, a business gets 12 months for the price of 10.
earn.label: Commission
earn.h2: Once per new business, from its first payment.
earn.intro: On a monthly plan you get a share of the first payment after taxes and the payment provider's fee. On a yearly plan the amount is fixed, and usually higher.
earn.fig: Three stacks of coins for three plans; the bigger the plan, the taller the stack
earn.fine: Amounts marked ≈ are estimates, worked out with 20% tax and a payment fee of about 3%. The real figure depends on the customer's country and card. Yearly amounts are fixed. Commissions are booked in Turkish lira; sales in other currencies convert at the Central Bank of Turkey rate on the payment day.
tip.d: Paying yearly, the business gets 2 months free. On Smart you earn about four times what a monthly sale pays.
calc.per: At this pace, in one month
calc.note: Commission is paid once per business; renewals, new branches and plan upgrades earn nothing extra. This is an example, not a promise of income.
how.label: How it works
how.h2: From code to bank transfer in four steps.
how.s1.d: Sign up with your name, email and country, then verify your email. Once your profile and bank details are complete, your code starting with AOM appears in the portal and in your inbox.
how.s2.d: Open the menu on your phone and walk through the plans. The owner signs up to Art of Menu themselves and enters your code before the first payment. A code can't be added afterwards.
how.s3.d: The day the payment reaches us, your commission shows as "pending" in the portal. If there's no refund or cancellation within 37 days, it becomes payable.
how.s4.d: Once your payable balance passes 1,000 TRY for a bank in Turkey, or €200 or $200 for a bank abroad, we send it by bank transfer.
who.label: Who it's for
who.h2: Anyone who already walks into restaurants for work.
who.1.d: While you set up the till, you can bring up the QR menu too. Same table, same owner, a second product.
who.2.d: You're designing the printed menu anyway, so suggest the QR code that sits on the table. You know that menu better than anyone.
who.3.d: If you run a café's Instagram, its guests can read the menu in their own language. One more service for your client.
who.4.d: If you talk to dozens of owners a week, keep your code in your pocket. There's no target; work as much as you like.
faq.label: Questions
faq.h2: What to know before you start.
faq.intro: Anything not answered here is in the terms.
faq.1.a: A commission becomes payable 37 days after the business's payment arrives. We send a transfer once your balance passes the minimum: 1,000 TRY for a bank in Turkey, €200 or $200 for a bank abroad. Anything below rolls over to the next round.
faq.2.q: Do I earn again when the subscription renews?
faq.2.a: No. You earn once per business, from its first paid payment. Renewals, branches added later and plan upgrades don't pay commission.
faq.3.q: I don't have a company. Can I join?
faq.3.a: Yes. Anyone 18 or over can join as an individual; we issue a payment receipt and withhold the tax Turkish law requires. If you join as a company, you invoice us for your commission.
faq.4.q: Can I offer the business a discount?
faq.4.a: No. Unapproved discounts, gifts or passing part of your commission to the business break the terms. Prices are the same for everyone.
faq.5.a: You can talk about Art of Menu on your own channels. Search ads on the Art of Menu name or similar words, domains or social accounts using the name, and unsolicited bulk messages are not allowed.
faq.6.q: Can I use my code for my own café?
faq.6.a: No commission is paid for your own business or any business you co-own or manage. The code is for new businesses you introduce.
faq.7.q: Can I sell to businesses in other countries?
faq.7.a: Yes. Art of Menu sells in lira in Turkey, in euros in Europe and in dollars elsewhere. Your commission is booked in lira and converted at the Central Bank of Turkey rate on the payment day. Intermediary bank fees on international transfers are yours.
faq.8.q: Two partners visited the same business. Who earns?
faq.8.a: The partner whose code was entered before the first payment. Each business belongs to one partner, and commission is paid once.
end.h2: Get your code and visit your first café this week.
end.p: Signing up takes a few minutes. Your code arrives once your profile and bank details are complete; after that, you show the menu on your phone.
